description: A small stack of colorful plastic plates sits on a green tablecloth near the right edge of the table. The right hand reaches in to touch the top yellow plate and slides it to the right to unstack it, then lifts and shifts the next plates so they end up spread out—green to the left, red in the middle, yellow to the right—with a blue plate pulled down toward the bottom; the right hand releases after each move and no left hand is involved.
